rationale: Adjust. Week of 9 Nov came in at 30.2 km against ~36 planned, with the calf felt on three of four runs and the HRV baseline sliding 36→32 (12 Nov flag, RHR 52, no confounder). 16–22 Nov was planned at 58 km against a ramp cap of 37.8, so it is cut to ~38 with the long run reduced to 8 km. 23–29 Nov was marked under the curve (56 vs 67.9); I am NOT raising it, because two gates hold it — the repeated calf notes and the unexplained HRV slide — and it is lowered to ~48 provisionally. 30 Nov–6 Dec is added at ~52, provisional. If Tuesday's run is silent and HRV recovers, next Sunday moves toward the curve.
